newsitem.title: CHINA: China military hikes civilian production.
newsitem.headline: China military hikes civilian production.

text.p: China's military industry has sharply increased production of civilian goods after more than a decade of transformation, the Financial News said on Wednesday.

Civilian products accounted for 80 percent of total industrial output of China's military firms in 1995, it quoted officials of the State Commission for Science, Technology and Industry for National Defence as saying.
China's military industries have the capacity to manufacture 15,000 types of civilian products ranging from nuclear detecting equipment to colour televisions, it said.
Production by military firms accounted for one-third of all motorcycles and one-sixth of small cars, it said. Colour television production accounted for 30 percent of the national total.
The industry has earned billions of U.S. dollars through exports of electrical goods, ship building and contracts in satellite launching for foreign companies, it said.
